args.summary: The v2.3.1 deployment of checkout-api began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 18%. Automated remediation performed: rolled back checkout-api in all production regions from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production (per deployment history; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and also unhealthy). Post-rollback verification: all regions running v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate down to 0.2%. Recommend investigating the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what was done:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Identified the rollback target**: v2.3.0 was the most recent release with a healthy production status (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and also unhealthy).
3. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions.
4. **Verified recovery**: all regions now running v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate down to 0.2%.
5. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failure and the remediation steps taken.

Recommendation: root-cause the v2.3.1 failure before attempting another deploy.
